selection_basis: Reference coverage, reported land use, hemisphere and regional crop calendars; frozen before inference. No selection by model scores.

comparison.postprocessing: Same as example 23: 1000 m2 minimum, 2 m simplification, no smoothing/SAM/LULC

netherlands.attribution: RVO / PDOK; converted and subset by Kerner Lab, Fields of The World
netherlands.reference_kind: Annual BRP crop declarations based on the agricultural reference register; not cadastral ownership boundaries
netherlands.coverage: FTW arable-land subset; grassland and other excluded classes are absent. Unmatched predictions are not all proven non-fields.
netherlands.position_uncertainty: No numerical positional accuracy stated in the conversion metadata; agricultural reference/declaration geometry can differ from physical edges.

spain.attribution: SIGPAC Navarra / EuroCrops; converted and subset by Kerner Lab, Fields of The World
spain.reference_kind: SIGPAC agricultural land-use enclosures, including arable and perennial classes; not exhaustive physical field truth
spain.coverage: Selected agricultural classes only; ARABLE LAND is a use class, not a crop species or an irrigation label.
spain.position_uncertainty: No numerical positional accuracy stated in the conversion metadata; use-class and declaration splits may have invisible edges.

southafrica.attribution: ESA Fusion Competition crop ground-reference data; converted by Kerner Lab, Fields of The World
southafrica.reference_kind: Crop-labeled field/cadastral reference from the ESA classification challenge; physical edge equivalence is not guaranteed
southafrica.coverage: Western Cape challenge area only, five included grain/forage classes; completeness outside those classes is not established.
southafrica.position_uncertainty: No numerical positional accuracy stated in the conversion metadata.

vietnam.attribution: AI4SmallFarms, Persello et al., University of Twente / TU Delft / DLR; converted by Kerner Lab, Fields of The World
vietnam.reference_kind: All visible agricultural fields manually digitized within surveyed tiles using Sentinel-2 and very-high-resolution imagery
vietnam.coverage: Approximately 5 km tiles only. Chosen boxes lie inside tiles, but the dataset has no per-field crop species labels.
vietnam.position_uncertainty: Multi-stage quality and topology checks, no numerical positional accuracy supplied. Digitization is August 2021; seasonal windows are earlier in the same year.

sites.crop_context: Reference declarations dominated by silage maize, with consumption potatoes and sugar beet; no species inferred from imagery
sites.rationale: Temperate summer arable comparison with several labeled crop species and medium-sized fields
sites.calendar_basis: Summer growing window for the crop declarations, consistent with the French baseline window

sites.region: Navarra, Ribera del Ebro near Valtierra
sites.climate: Dry Mediterranean continental / semi-arid regional context
sites.crop_context: Arable and vegetable-use enclosures in a documented irrigation region; neither species nor irrigation is confirmed for every field
sites.rationale: Summer crops in a dry regional climate, contrasting with temperate and tropical sites
sites.calendar_basis: Summer window; regional crop map and irrigation documentation, not field-specific planting dates

sites.crop_context: Reference arable-use enclosures, vineyards and olive plots; arable crop species unknown
sites.rationale: Small mixed annual/perennial enclosures; a spring-to-harvest window contrasting with the Ribera summer window
sites.calendar_basis: Spring and early summer cover annual crop growth/harvest alongside perennial cultivation

sites.climate: Southern Cape winter-growing grain region; Mediterranean-to-coastal rainfall transition
sites.crop_context: Labeled wheat, barley, canola, small-grain grazing and lucerne/medics; large parcels relative to other selected sites
sites.rationale: Southern Hemisphere winter/spring commercial grain and forage reference case
sites.calendar_basis: Winter/spring grain development, July through October; no Northern Hemisphere summer assumption

sites.region: Thai Binh province, Red River Delta (2021 administrative names)
sites.climate: Northern monsoonal climate with cooler winters
sites.crop_context: Smallholder fields in a documented rice-based delta; species unmeasured at field level
sites.rationale: Very small fields within one fully digitized tile; winter/spring rice regional calendar
sites.vintage_note: Same reference year, but imagery February-May precedes August digitization; field rearrangements cannot be ruled out

sites.region: Dong Thap province, Mekong Delta near Cao Lanh (2021 administrative names)
sites.climate: Humid tropical monsoonal; dry-season observation window
sites.crop_context: Fields in a documented multiple-rice-cropping delta; species unmeasured at field level
sites.rationale: Tropical rice regional context and less fragmented reference fields than the northern tile
sites.vintage_note: Same reference year, but imagery January-April precedes August digitization; field rearrangements cannot be ruled out

gaps: Irrigation is supported as regional context in Valtierra, not as a verified field-level attribute; no pure irrigated-versus-rainfed contrast is claimed.
Vietnam has no species labels, so the rice interpretation is regional context, not a measured crop-stratified result.
India, Kenya and Rwanda FTW subsets have presence-only labels; excluded from full-area precision/oversegmentation comparisons.
Global machine-predicted field maps were excluded as independent ground truth.
No fully documented ground-survey positional uncertainty or guaranteed geographical holdout from the pretrained checkpoint is available.
